questions.questionText: The cell surface membrane structure is described as a ‘fluid mosaic’. What correctly describes the ‘mosaic’ part of the cell surface membrane?

options.B: the random distribution of cholesterol molecules within the phospholipid bilayer
options.C: the regular pattern produced by the phospholipid heads and membrane proteins

Asthma can affect children and adults. The air passages become narrower, severely restricting the flow of air into the lungs. Salbutamol is a drug that widens the air passages to relieve the symptoms of asthma. How does salbutamol relieve the symptoms of asthma?

options.A: It decreases mucus secretions in the terminal bronchioles.
options.B: It decreases the surface area of the alveoli.
options.C: It causes recoil of elastic tissue in the bronchioles.
options.D: It relaxes smooth muscle in the bronchi and bronchioles.

Which statements about an infectious disease may be correct?
Which statements explain why cholera has not been eradicated by vaccination?
Antibiotic resistance is a serious threat to global health. Which statement describes a step that can be taken to reduce the impact of antibiotic resistance?

options.A: Antibiotics prescribed by a doctor should be shared with family members to protect them.
options.B: Antibiotics should only be used to treat infectious diseases caused by viruses.
options.C: Farmers should give antibiotics to healthy animals to prevent infections occurring.
options.D: Vaccination programmes should be used to reduce the spread of bacterial diseases.

questions.questionText: Tetanus is an infectious disease caused by a type of bacterium. This bacterium produces a protein that is a toxin which causes illness. Scientists have produced a vaccine for tetanus which contains a harmless form of the toxin called a toxoid. The toxoid is produced by mixing the toxin with the chemical formaldehyde. This chemical binds to the toxin making it harmless. Which statement about the tetanus vaccine is correct?

options.A: After vaccination, the toxoid in the vaccine will be ingested by neutrophils and displayed in their cell surface membranes.
options.B: The tetanus vaccine containing the toxoid does not contain antigens because it does not contain any cells of the pathogen.
options.C: The toxoid protein in the vaccine stimulates the production of antibodies which remain in the blood to provide long-term immunity.
options.D: When formaldehyde binds to the toxin, it causes the toxin to completely change shape.
